row.title: Node 24 in workflows; Node maintenance horizon check
row.body: Workflow Node pins moved from 22 to 24 (maintenance to 2028-04-30) on a protected branch Rowan approved; compatdate --check now fails any pin whose Node major leaves maintenance within 365 days, closing node-runtime in the unattended register so all three seeds reach autonomous.
